transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, nice to meet you, Doc. I came in because... well, lately I just keep having these thoughts. I keep thinking that maybe my family would be better off if I just didn't wake up. 

It really shook me up, honestly. It scared me enough that I actually told my supervisor at work about it, and... well, that's why I'm sitting here today.
Can you tell me how long you've been feeling this way—weeks, months, or longer?
I'd say it's been about two weeks. This whole change in me... it really started right around the time my daughter left Georgia for the military.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than normal?

Yeah, actually, I have. There was a time a while back where I just had so much energy. I'd be up way before daylight, sitting there planning out all these changes for the warehouse at work. And then I'd be right to cleaning the garage at home... just jumping from one job to the next. I really didn't even want to stop to take a break.
During these past two weeks of feeling down, have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things others don't, or having beliefs that others find strange or unfounded?

No, doc, nothing like that. I haven't heard any voices or... seen anything that wasn't there. It's really just been those heavy thoughts I told you about. My mind isn't playing tricks on me or anything, I just feel really low.
Over these past two weeks, how has this low mood affected your ability to go to work, care for yourself, or manage your daily responsibilities?

Well, it's been pretty rough, to be honest. At work, I've been making mistakes... serious enough that one of the supervisors actually found me just sitting out in my truck before dawn. He ended up getting occupational health involved because of it. And at home, it's not much better. I've just been letting the bills and my normal responsibilities pile up. I usually handle all that stuff right away, but lately... I just haven't been doing it.
When you have these thoughts that your family would be better off without you, have you thought about how you might act on them, or made any specific plans?

No, I haven't made any specific plans like that. It's just... I keep having these thoughts that my family might be better off if I just didn't wake up. Honestly, having those thoughts scared me enough that I actually told my supervisor about it, and that's the whole reason I came in here today.
